hooks.command: f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath // empty'); if echo "$f" | grep -qE '\.swift$'; then cd /Users/geguo/Desktop/AP/ConsultantAI && swift build > /tmp/.consultantai_build_out 2>&1; code=$?; if [ $code -ne 0 ]; then count=$(grep -c ' error:' /tmp/.consultantai_build_out 2>/dev/null || echo 0); cp /tmp/.consultantai_build_out /tmp/.consultantai_build_error; echo "{\"systemMessage\": \"❌ 编译失败 ($count 个错误)，请检查代码\"}"; else rm -f /tmp/.consultantai_build_error; echo "{\"systemMessage\": \"✅ 编译通过\"}"; fi; fi
if [ -f /tmp/.consultantai_build_error ]; then count=$(grep -c ' error:' /tmp/.consultantai_build_error 2>/dev/null || echo 0); echo "{\"systemMessage\": \"⚠️ 仍有 $count 个编译错误未修复\"}"; fi
